clippings.speaker: Antonio Banderas
clippings.quote: And he said, "No. I understand that works for you, but it doesn't work for me. We have to deconstruct you and construct you in a different way." And that was painful.
clippings.title: How Antonio Banderas Learned to Relax and Play His Old Friend (and Director) Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.context: Banderas recalls Almodóvar's note during the 2011 shoot of The Skin I Live In, in a Cannes magazine interview for Pain and Glory.

clippings.speaker: Antonio Banderas
clippings.quote: Pedro Almodóvar is responsible for every word, every comma. That's something that actors find hard with Pedro.
clippings.title: How Antonio Banderas Learned to Relax and Play His Old Friend (and Director) Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.context: Banderas on how tightly scripted the improvised-looking Pain and Glory was, in a Cannes magazine interview.

clippings.speaker: Antonio Banderas
clippings.quote: I saw Pedro Almodóvar leave happier than we ever saw before. He was lighter by the end of the movie.
clippings.title: How Antonio Banderas Learned to Relax and Play His Old Friend (and Director) Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.context: Banderas on what making Pain and Glory, a film drawn from Almodóvar's own life, did for the director, in a Cannes magazine interview.

clippings.speaker: Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.quote: Antonio did not imitate me for a second. I told him he could do it if it helped him, but he refused. What he has done is something incredible. He has fictionalized me within the rules of my own universe as a writer.
clippings.title: Interview: Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.context: Almodóvar on how Banderas played his alter ego in Pain and Glory, in a Film Comment interview by Carlos Reviriego.

clippings.speaker: Pedro Almodóvar
clippings.quote: I don't know how to describe it, but there's something slightly different in your persona. Don't hide it for the character. Use it. We are talking about pain.
clippings.title: 'Pain and Glory': How Antonio Banderas and Pedro Almodóvar Made the Year's Most Beautifully Tender Movie
clippings.context: Almodóvar's remark to Banderas on an early shooting day, as recounted in Marlow Stern's joint-interview article.
